import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import lightgbm as lgb
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set paths based on actual data location
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Define columns
id_col = "id"
target_col = "target"

# Get all feature columns
train_feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col]]
test_feature_cols = [c for c in test_df.columns if c != id_col]

# Prepare features
X_train = train_df[train_feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col].values
X_test = test_df[test_feature_cols].copy()

# Identify categorical columns (object dtype)
cat_cols = [col for col in train_feature_cols if train_df[col].dtype == "object"]
num_cols = [c for c in train_feature_cols if c not in cat_cols]

print(f"Feature columns: {len(train_feature_cols)}")
print(f"Categorical columns: {cat_cols}")
print(f"Numeric columns: {len(num_cols)}")


# Build target encoding map from training data only
def build_target_encoding_map(full_df, cat_cols, target_col, smoothing=5.0):
    """Build target encoding dictionary from full dataframe"""
    encoding_map = {}
    for col in cat_cols:
        target_means = full_df.groupby(col)[target_col].mean()
        category_counts = full_df.groupby(col).size()
        global_mean = full_df[target_col].mean()
        encoding_map[col] = {}
        for category in target_means.index:
            count = category_counts[category]
            smooth_val = (target_means[category] * count + global_mean * smoothing) / (
                count + smoothing
            )
            encoding_map[col][category] = smooth_val
        encoding_map[col]["_nan"] = global_mean
    return encoding_map


def apply_target_encoding(df, encoding_map, cat_cols):
    """Apply pre-built encoding map to any dataframe"""
    result_df = df.copy()
    for col in cat_cols:
        if col in result_df.columns:
            result_df[col] = result_df[col].apply(
                lambda x: (
                    encoding_map[col][x]
                    if x in encoding_map[col]
                    else encoding_map[col]["_nan"]
                )
            )
    return result_df


# Build target encoding map and apply
print("Building target encoding map from training data...")
encoding_map = build_target_encoding_map(train_df, cat_cols, target_col, smoothing=5.0)
print("Applying target encoding...")
X_train_encoded = apply_target_encoding(X_train, encoding_map, cat_cols)
X_test_encoded = apply_target_encoding(X_test, encoding_map, cat_cols)

# Combine numeric and encoded columns
all_feature_cols = num_cols + cat_cols
X_train_final = X_train_encoded[all_feature_cols].copy()
X_test_final = X_test_encoded[all_feature_cols].copy()

# Calculate variance for each numeric feature to identify high-variance features
variances = X_train_final[num_cols].var()
sorted_variances = variances.sort_values(ascending=False)
print("Top 10 highest variance numeric features:")
print(sorted_variances.head(10))

# Select top variance numeric features for interactions (excluding f_28)
high_variance_numeric = ["f_26", "f_25", "f_24", "f_23", "f_22"]
# Remove f_28 from the list
high_variance_numeric = [
    col for col in high_variance_numeric if col in num_cols and col != "f_28"
]

print(f"High variance numeric features for interaction: {high_variance_numeric}")

# Create interaction features between f_27 (encoded) and high-variance numeric features
print("Creating interaction features...")
f_27_encoded_col = "f_27"
for num_feat in high_variance_numeric:
    if num_feat in X_train_final.columns and f_27_encoded_col in X_train_final.columns:
        interaction_col = f"{f_27_encoded_col}_{num_feat}"
        X_train_final[interaction_col] = (
            X_train_final[f_27_encoded_col] * X_train_final[num_feat]
        )
        X_test_final[interaction_col] = (
            X_test_final[f_27_encoded_col] * X_test_final[num_feat]
        )

# Also add polynomial interaction features for top variance numerics
print("Adding polynomial interaction features...")
polynomial_interactions = ["f_26", "f_25"]
for num_feat1 in polynomial_interactions:
    for num_feat2 in polynomial_interactions:
        if (
            num_feat1 != num_feat2
            and num_feat1 in X_train_final.columns
            and num_feat2 in X_train_final.columns
        ):
            interaction_col = f"{num_feat1}_{num_feat2}_poly"
            X_train_final[interaction_col] = (
                X_train_final[num_feat1] * X_train_final[num_feat2]
            )
            X_test_final[interaction_col] = (
                X_test_final[num_feat1] * X_test_final[num_feat2]
            )

# Standardize numeric features
scaler = StandardScaler()
columns_to_scale = num_cols + [
    col for col in X_train_final.columns if col not in cat_cols
]
X_train_final[columns_to_scale] = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_final[columns_to_scale])
X_test_final[columns_to_scale] = scaler.transform(X_test_final[columns_to_scale])

# Create a genuine hold-out validation split
print("Creating validation split...")
X_train_fold, X_val_fold, y_train_fold, y_val_fold = train_test_split(
    X_train_final, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training split size: {X_train_fold.shape[0]}")
print(f"Validation split size: {X_val_fold.shape[0]}")

# Train LightGBM model with optimized parameters
print("Training LightGBM model...")
clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=8,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=127,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
clf.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

# Evaluate on genuine hold-out validation
y_val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val_fold)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_fold, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.5f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]

# Save submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df[id_col], "target": test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)

print(
    f"Submission saved to {submission_dir}/submission.csv with {len(submission_df)} rows"
)
print("Validation AUC-ROC score:", val_auc)
